In article <3s8omi$5...@news.alaska.edu>,
KERIN BRITTON L <fs...@aurora.alaska.edu> wrote:
>In the case of Psyche vs. Fast Reaction or Psyche vs. Hidden Lurker, which
>takes precedence? How about Fast Reaction vs. Hidden Lurker? If anyone
>has an opinion or resolution for this question, I would really appreciate
>it if they would mail it to me as well as posting it, news doesn't work
>easily from my server. I am Britton Kerin at fs...@aurora.alaska.edu.
>Thanks.

Phsyche would win over any of the others, since it is a combat card - to
be played at the end of combat. The others must Wait until after the
end of combat.

Fast Reaction vs. Hidden Lurker - Hidden Lurker wins since the acting player
gets to play first. If you ask the acting player if she's done with her
action (declines to play further action modifiers on the action), then you
may play Fast Reaction without fear. The acting player cannot change her mind
after seeing that you want to try to attck the acting minion.
